'''Gaccerin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the conflict, she served the Empire as an [[Imperial Agent]] in [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] and worked on board the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Vaiken Spacedock]], located within the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial fleet]]. Gaccerin worked selling equipment to other Imperials in the station's supply section, and while doing so wore [[Color/Legends|gray]] [[Armor/Legends|armor]] including a helmet and also made use of a hand-held [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojector]]. She had brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and fair skin.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Gaccerin was created for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', an [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. In the game she serves as an Imperial elite gear vendor within the Imperial fleet. She was later removed as a vendor and NPC in Game Update 5.0 on [[November 29]], [[2016]], which retired the PvP and PvE gear vendors in favor of the Command system. Nonetheless, she remains in the game, as her character model is used as part of the background environment in the redesigned fleet areas.<ref name="5.0">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/11292016/game-update-5.0-knights-eternal-throne-early-access|text=Game Update 5.0: Knights of the Eternal Throne Early Access Patch Notes}}</ref>
